verdict.rationale: Snyk documents natural-language operation through its own MCP server and Snyk Studio: users prompt a coding agent with requests like "scan my directory for security issues". It also ships an LLM-driven Remediation Agent invoked via `/snyk-fix`, `/snyk-batch-fix` and `snyk fix --agentic`. The natural-language layer depends on a third-party coding assistant, and the documentation shows only scanning and fixing being driven this way. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface within Snyk itself, natural-language coverage of broader product operations beyond scan/fix, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: To validate the MCP server configuration, prompt your coding agent with natural language, for example, "scan my directory for security issues".
The Remediation Agent is an LLM-driven tool that automates vulnerability remediation in your projects.
Run `/snyk-fix` in your coding assistant to scan the project and apply a fix for the top vulnerability.
